limitations: Closure review was limited to the two previously identified report-quality findings and contradictions potentially introduced by their revisions; it was not a general whole-project audit, product approval, fleet-wide safety determination, or no-misuse certificate.

PSA-001 now limits its claim to running Xray, enabled unlimited clients, and increasing inbound counters, and explicitly states that these counters do not prove end-to-end forwarding or billed proxy traffic.

PSA-006 is supported by collector metadata documenting case-insensitive checks of http_proxy, https_proxy, all_proxy, and no_proxy names in live /proc/PID/environ snapshots; those snapshots are not end-to-end transport traces.
The 73 unreachable Vultr panel records, historical routing, provider billing attribution, external credential use, and exact Xray probe execution remain unverified as stated in the report.

scope_note: Multiple full report/source reviews led to factual and scope corrections. Final API PASS closes the two remaining report-quality revisions; it is not a product/security approval or proof of no misuse.
